mapper.select: /* saleson.shop.mypage.MypageMapper.intrstLocGovInfo */ SELECT a.locgov_code, b.upper_locgov_nm, b.locgov_nm, b.upper_locgov_code, ( select IFNULL(SUM(d.cntr_amt),0) from g_cntr d where d.user_id = c.user_id and d.cntr_locgov_code = a.locgov_code and d.sttemnt_pay_de is not null and d.delete_at = 'N' and d.cntr_sttus_code = '200' )as cntr_amt, ( select gcs.point_rate from g_ctbny_setup gcs where gcs.locgov_code = a.locgov_code and gcs.stdr_year = to_char(sysdate, 'yyyy') ) as point_rate FROM g_intrst_locgov a, g_locgov b , op_user c where a.locgov_code = b.locgov_code and a.user_id = c.user_id AND a.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY a.locgov_code ASC

/* saleson.shop.mypage.MypageMapper.getCntrPointCnt */ select count(a.cntr_sn) from ( SELECT c.locgov_code , c.upper_locgov_nm , c.locgov_nm , a.cntr_sn , sum(a.cntr_point) , ( SELECT IFNULL(SUM(d.cntr_use_point),0) FROM g_cntr_use_point d WHERE d.user_id = a.USER_ID AND d.cntr_locgov_code = a.cntr_locgov_code AND d.use_se_code = '1' ) as cntr_use_point, -- 사용포인트 sum(a.cntr_blce_point) FROM g_cntr a, op_user b, g_locgov c WHERE a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.delete_at ='N' AND a.cntr_locgov_code = c.locgov_code group by a.cntr_locgov_code ORDER BY a.frst_regist_pnttm desc ) a

/* saleson.shop.mypage.MypageMapper.getCntrPointInfo */ SELECT T_A.* , T_A.CNTR_POINT - T_A.CNTR_USE_POINT AS CNTR_BLCE_POINT FROM ( SELECT C.LOCGOV_CODE , C.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM , C.LOCGOV_NM , A.CNTR_SN , SUM(A.CNTR_POINT) AS CNTR_POINT, ( SELECT IFNULL(SUM(D.CNTR_USE_POINT),0) FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT D WHERE D.USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND D.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE ) AS CNTR_USE_POINT, -- 사용포인트 (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(USER_ID),0, '일반', '명예기부자') FROM G_HONOR_CNTRBTR WHERE USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND LOCGOV_CODE = A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE) AS USER_GRADE, CASE WHEN E.CNT > 0 THEN E.DETAIL || ' 등 ' || CNT || '건' ELSE E.DETAIL END AS DETAIL FROM OP_USER B JOIN G_CNTR A ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND A.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND A.DELETE_AT ='N' AND A.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL JOIN G_LOCGOV C ON A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = C.LOCGOV_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE, LINK_INSTT_CD, CASE WHEN D.DETAIL IS NULL THEN '고향사랑e음' ELSE D.DETAIL END AS DETAIL, COUNT(LINK_INSTT_CD) OVER(PARTITION BY CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE) AS CNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE ORDER BY count(*) DESC) AS RN FROM G_CNTR A LEFT JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE D ON D.ID = A.LINK_INSTT_CD AND D.CODE_TYPE = 'LINK_INSTT_CD' WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE, LINK_INSTT_CD ) E ON E.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE AND E.RN = 1 WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE ORDER BY A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM DESC
) T_A

/* saleson.shop.mypage.MypageMapper.getCntrPointDetailCnt */ SELECT count(cntr_sn) as cnt FROM( SELECT GC.cntr_sn , CNTR_DE , OU.USER_NAME , OU.LOGIN_ID , CNTR_AMT , CNTR_POINT , '' AS CNTR_USE_POINT , (SELECT SUM(CNTR_POINT) FROM G_CNTR A WHERE A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM <= GC.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM AND A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE AND A.USER_ID = GC.USER_ID AND A.DELETE_AT ='N') AS CURRENT_CNTR_POINT , (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CNTR_USE_POINT), 0) FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT A WHERE A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM <= GC.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM AND A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE AND A.USER_ID = GC.USER_ID) AS CURRENT_CNTR_USE_POINT , FRST_REGIST_PNTTM , '' as ORDER_CODE , '' as URL_ADRES FROM G_CNTR GC, OP_USER OU WHERE 1=1 AND GC.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND GC.USER_ID = OU.USER_ID AND GC.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND GC.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = #{locgovCode} AND OU.USER_ID = #{userId} UNION ALL SELECT GC.cntr_sn , POINT_USE_DE AS CNTR_DE , OU.USER_NAME , OU.LOGIN_ID , '' AS CNTR_AMT , '' AS CNTR_POINT , CNTR_USE_POINT , (SELECT SUM(CNTR_POINT) FROM G_CNTR A WHERE A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM <= GC.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM AND A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE AND A.USER_ID = GC.USER_ID AND A.DELETE_AT ='N') AS CURRENT_CNTR_POINT , (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CNTR_USE_POINT), 0) FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT A WHERE A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM <= GC.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM AND A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE AND A.USER_ID = GC.USER_ID) AS CURRENT_CNTR_USE_POINT , FRST_REGIST_PNTTM , GC.ORDER_CODE , GC.URL_ADRES FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT GC, OP_USER OU WHERE 1=1 AND GC.USER_ID = OU.USER_ID AND GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = #{locgovCode} AND OU.USER_ID = #{userId} ) A ORDER BY FRST_REGIST_PNTTM DESC

/* saleson.shop.mypage.MypageMapper.getCntrPointDetail */ SELECT cntr_sn , DATE_FORMAT(CNTR_DE, '%Y.%m.%d') as CNTR_DE , USER_NAME , LOGIN_ID , CAST(CNTR_AMT AS VARCHAR) AS CNTR_AMT , CAST(CNTR_POINT AS VARCHAR) AS CNTR_POINT , CAST(CNTR_USE_POINT AS VARCHAR) AS CNTR_USE_POINT , (CURRENT_CNTR_POINT - CURRENT_CNTR_USE_POINT) AS CNTR_BLCE_POINT , ORDER_CODE , URL_ADRES FROM( SELECT GC.cntr_sn , CNTR_DE , CRYPTO_DEC('normal', OU.USER_NAME, '', 0) AS USER_NAME , CRYPTO_DEC('normal', OU.LOGIN_ID, '', 0) AS LOGIN_ID , CNTR_AMT , CNTR_POINT , '' AS CNTR_USE_POINT , (SELECT SUM(CNTR_POINT) FROM G_CNTR A WHERE A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM <= GC.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM AND A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE AND A.USER_ID = GC.USER_ID AND A.DELETE_AT ='N') AS CURRENT_CNTR_POINT , (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CNTR_USE_POINT), 0) FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT A WHERE A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM <= GC.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM AND A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE AND A.USER_ID = GC.USER_ID) AS CURRENT_CNTR_USE_POINT , FRST_REGIST_PNTTM , '' as ORDER_CODE , '' as URL_ADRES FROM G_CNTR GC, OP_USER OU WHERE 1=1 AND GC.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND GC.USER_ID = OU.USER_ID AND GC.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND GC.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = #{locgovCode} AND OU.USER_ID = #{userId} UNION ALL SELECT GC.cntr_sn , POINT_USE_DE AS CNTR_DE , CRYPTO_DEC('normal', OU.USER_NAME, '', 0) AS USER_NAME , CRYPTO_DEC('normal', OU.LOGIN_ID, '', 0) AS LOGIN_ID , '' AS CNTR_AMT , '' AS CNTR_POINT , CNTR_USE_POINT , (SELECT SUM(CNTR_POINT) FROM G_CNTR A WHERE A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM <= GC.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM AND A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE AND A.USER_ID = GC.USER_ID AND A.DELETE_AT ='N') AS CURRENT_CNTR_POINT , (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CNTR_USE_POINT), 0) FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT A WHERE A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM <= GC.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM AND A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE AND A.USER_ID = GC.USER_ID) AS CURRENT_CNTR_USE_POINT , FRST_REGIST_PNTTM , GC.ORDER_CODE , GC.URL_ADRES FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT GC, OP_USER OU WHERE 1=1 AND GC.USER_ID = OU.USER_ID AND GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = #{locgovCode} AND OU.USER_ID = #{userId} ) A ORDER BY FRST_REGIST_PNTTM DESC

/* saleson.shop.mypage.MypageMapper.getTotalCntrAmt */ SELECT IFNULL(SUM(a.cntr_amt),0) as cntr_amt FROM g_cntr a, op_user b WHERE a.user_id = b.user_id AND b.user_id =#{userId} AND a.sttemnt_pay_de is not null AND a.delete_at = 'N' AND a.cntr_sttus_code = '200'

/* saleson.shop.mypage.MypageMapper.getTotalCntrAmt */ SELECT IFNULL(SUM(GC.CNTR_AMT), 0) AS CNTR_AMT FROM G_CNTR GC JOIN OP_USER U ON GC.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND U.USER_ID = #{userId} AND GC.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND GC.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND GC.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND GC.CNTR_DE LIKE CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(SYSDATE, '%Y'), '%')
/* saleson.shop.mypage.MypageMapper.getLocGovList */ SELECT LOCGOV_CODE, LOCGOV_NM, UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE FROM G_LOCGOV WHERE USE_AT = 'Y' AND UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE = #{upperLocgovCode} ORDER BY ORDERING

/* saleson.shop.mypage.MypageMapper.getOrderLevelList */ SELECT A.ID AS ORDER_STATUS, A.LABEL AS ORDER_LABEL, COUNT(B.ORDER_STATUS) AS ORDER_COUNT FROM OP_COMMON_CODE A LEFT JOIN OP_ORDER_ITEM B ON A.ID = B.ORDER_STATUS AND B.USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE A.CODE_TYPE = 'ORDER_STATUS' AND A.ID IN ('10', '20', '30', '35', '40') GROUP BY A.ID UNION ALL SELECT A.ID AS ORDER_STATUS, SUBSTR(A.LABEL, 0, 2) AS ORDER_LABEL, COUNT(B.ORDER_STATUS) AS ORDER_COUNT FROM OP_COMMON_CODE A LEFT JOIN OP_ORDER_ITEM B ON A.ID = B.ORDER_STATUS AND B.USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE A.CODE_TYPE = 'ORDER_STATUS' AND A.ID IN ('50', '55', '58', '59', '60', '65', '69', '70', '75', '79') GROUP BY SUBSTR(A.ID, 0, 1)

/* saleson.shop.mypage.MypageMapper.getOrderClaimLevelList */ SELECT A.ID AS ORDER_STATUS, A.LABEL AS ORDER_LABEL FROM OP_COMMON_CODE A WHERE A.CODE_TYPE = 'ORDER_STATUS' AND A.ID IN ('50', '55', '58', '60', '65', '70', '75') GROUP BY A.ID ORDER BY A.LABEL DESC
mapper.insert: /* saleson.shop.mypage.MypageMapper.insertCntrReceipt */ INSERT INTO G_CNTR_RCIPT ( CNTR_OUTPT_SN ,CNTR_SN ,ELCTRN_PAY_NO ,ISSU_DE ,FRST_REGISTER_ID ,FRST_REGIST_PNTTM ,LAST_UPDUSR_ID ,LAST_UPDT_PNTTM ) SELECT ( SELECT NVL(MAX(CNTR_OUTPT_SN), 0) + 1 FROM G_CNTR_RCIPT ) AS CNTR_OUTPT_SN ,CNTR_SN ,ELCTRN_PAY_NO , ,#{userId} , ,#{userId} , FROM G_CNTR WHERE CNTR_SN = #{cntrSn} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: /* saleson.shop.mypage.MypageMapper.getUserHonorListTotal */ SELECT OCC.ID AS HONOR_CNTRBTR_LEVEL_CODE ,OCC.LABEL ,COUNT(CASE WHEN GHC.HONOR_CNTRBTR_LEVEL_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS LEVEL_CNT FROM OP_COMMON_CODE OCC LEFT OUTER JOIN G_HONOR_CNTRBTR GHC ON OCC.ID = GHC.HONOR_CNTRBTR_LEVEL_CODE AND USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE CODE_TYPE ='HONOR_STD' GROUP BY OCC.ID, OCC.LABEL ORDER BY OCC.ID DESC

/* saleson.shop.mypage.MypageMapper.getUserHonorList */ SELECT GHC.STDR_YEAR ,GL.LOCGOV_CODE ,GL.LOCGOV_NM ,GHC.HONOR_CNTRBTR_LEVEL_CODE ,OCC.LABEL ,GL.UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE AS UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE ,(SELECT LABEL FROM OP_COMMON_CODE OCC WHERE ID = GL.UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE AND CODE_TYPE = 'WDR' AND USE_YN = 'Y') AS UPPER_LOCGOV_NM FROM G_HONOR_CNTRBTR GHC INNER JOIN G_LOCGOV GL ON GHC.LOCGOV_CODE = GL.LOCGOV_CODE INNER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE OCC ON CODE_TYPE ='HONOR_STD' AND GHC.HONOR_CNTRBTR_LEVEL_CODE = OCC.ID WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY GHC.STDR_YEAR, GHC.HONOR_CNTRBTR_LEVEL_CODE DESC, GHC.LOCGOV_CODE

/* saleson.shop.mypage.MypageMapper.getUserCntrHonorList */ SELECT * , SUM( CASE WHEN T_B.GRADE = 'GOLD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) OVER() AS GOLD_CNT , SUM( CASE WHEN T_B.GRADE = 'SILVER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) OVER() AS SILVER_CNT , SUM( CASE WHEN T_B.GRADE = 'BRONZE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) OVER() AS BRONZE_CNT , ADDDATE(ADDDATE(TO_DATE(PUB_DE, 'YYYYMMDD'), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), INTERVAL -1 DAY) AS EXP_DE FROM ( SELECT LOCGOV_CODE , STDR_3LEVEL_AMT , STDR_2LEVEL_AMT , STDR_1LEVEL_AMT , CASE WHEN TOTAL_CNTR_AMT >= STDR_3LEVEL_AMT THEN 'GOLD' WHEN TOTAL_CNTR_AMT >= STDR_2LEVEL_AMT THEN 'SILVER' WHEN TOTAL_CNTR_AMT >= STDR_1LEVEL_AMT THEN 'BRONZE' ELSE '' END AS GRADE , LOC_NM , USER_LOC_NM , PUB_DE FROM ( SELECT C.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE AS LOCGOV_CODE , SUM(C.CNTR_AMT) AS TOTAL_CNTR_AMT , IFNULL(L.STDR_1LEVEL_AMT, 0) AS STDR_1LEVEL_AMT , IFNULL(L.STDR_2LEVEL_AMT, 0) AS STDR_2LEVEL_AMT , IFNULL(L.STDR_3LEVEL_AMT, 0) AS STDR_3LEVEL_AMT , L.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM || ' ' || L.LOCGOV_NM AS LOC_NM , L2.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM || ' ' || L2.LOCGOV_NM AS USER_LOC_NM , MAX(C.CNTR_DE) AS PUB_DE FROM ( SELECT CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE , CNTR_AMT , PSITN_LOCGOV_CODE , CNTR_DE FROM G_CNTR WHERE 1=1 AND USER_ID = #{value} AND STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NOT NULL AND CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' AND DELETE_AT = 'N'
AND CNTR_DE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE(ADDDATE(SYSDATE, INTERVAL -1 YEAR), INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y%m%D') AND DATE_FORMAT(SYS_DATE, '%Y%m%D') ORDER BY CNTR_SN DESC ) C LEFT OUTER JOIN G_LOCGOV L ON C.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE = L.LOCGOV_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN G_LOCGOV L2 ON C.PSITN_LOCGOV_CODE = L2.LOCGOV_CODE GROUP BY C.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE ) T_A ) T_B WHERE T_B.STDR_3LEVEL_AMT > 0 AND T_B.GRADE <> '' AND T_B.GRADE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T_B.LOCGOV_CODE

/* saleson.shop.mypage.MypageMapper.getReceiptCntrPopInfo */ SELECT IFNULL(SUM(cntr_amt),0) as cntr_amt ,count(*) as cntr_cnt FROM G_CNTR WHERE CNTR_SN IN
#{cntrSn}
